body_force_screen.method: mass * longitudinal_acceleration + mass * Unity drag * speed

per_wheel.interpretation: steady plateaus test collider-radius slip mapping; transient mismatch is retained as wheel rotational-state evidence, not absorbed into a force or tire parameter

wheel_rotational_balance_screen.equation: I * d(angular_velocity)/dt + c * angular_velocity = motor_torque - sign(angular_velocity)*brake_torque - collider_radius * WheelHit.forward_curve_force
wheel_rotational_balance_screen.interpretation: positive-drive transitions identify a mechanical wheel-state screen; zero-throttle CAWB braking and positive throttle downsteps are retained as hybrid/downstep diagnostics. No value is promoted to the runtime plant.
